rationale: Build on the current best reverse-order recurrent-tail baseline with a minimal EvoNAS-style gated carryover transplant instead of another small LR or float-keep sweep. The repeated tail blocks now get a learned per-dimension carry path back toward the decoder-output anchor before applying their existing recurrent delta, preserving the winning late-skip/tail structure while giving recurrence a controlled state-reuse mechanism that is compile-stable, cheap in bytes, and directly targeted at final int8+zlib roundtrip quality.
title: Gated Decoder-Anchor Carry For Reverse Tail Recurrence
